text: ここに　すめば　けんきゅうも　はかどるな…

structure.jp: けんきゅうも　はかどるな…
structure.en: my research would go well too...

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: The ば ending means 'if'. すめば = 'if I lived (here)'.

patterns.name: 〜な (musing)
patterns.explanation: な at the end here is the speaker thinking out loud to himself, not telling anyone not to do something. はかどるな… = 'it would go well, I reckon...'
